author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Tyra engine showcase [PlayStation 2]
summary: H4570 demonstrates Tyra, an open-source game engine for PS2. The examples show sprites, models, animation, lighting and debugging tools.

blocks.text: This 58-second showcase presents Tyra 2.1.0 through several labeled examples. A first-person scene is followed by a simple greeting, a sprite, textured blocks, a rendered environment, animated characters and lighting tests. Later examples show debug geometry and a manually rendered triangle before a brief voxel-game scene. The changing labels are useful signposts: they separate capabilities that might otherwise look like one finished game.

The author links the Tyra repository, which contains examples and development documentation. The video shows the project at the time of recording, in August 2022. It is a demonstration of capabilities rather than a complete setup guide or performance comparison. Use current project documentation when setting up the engine, because the repository may have changed since these examples were recorded.
